primary_change: Classical motion application with elegant spring easing on cards and modals; restrained typography hierarchy emphasizing Merriweather serif headings for authority. Single-column home layout with balanced spacing philosophy to convey editorial credibility.
rationale: BrandSpec specifies motion_philosophy=classical and notes 'restrained elegance over flashiness' with 'typography-forward design with serif headings conveys authority and timelessness.' The ContentRecommendation chose preserve-and-modernize, so VisualDirection applies minimal deltas: strengthens motion specificity (assigns concrete classes to interactions), locks typography hierarchy to serif-led scale, and defines single-page layout for the home route. All tokens remain traceable to BrandSpec.
designer_notes: Classical philosophy: 400ms transitions on card hover with spring easing cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) and scale(1.02) — elegant, not bouncy.
Button hover uses motion-subtle (150ms opacity) to avoid competing with card interactions; primary motion weight is on cards and modals.
Headings use Merriweather 700 for h1/h2 (editorial authority); subheadings step down to 600 weight to maintain visual hierarchy without heaviness.
Label class uses uppercase + wide tracking for meta-information (eyebrow text, section labels) — reinforces editorial tone.
Dark mode is delegated to BrandSpec.full_tokens strategy; no delta required.
Spacing philosophy is 'balanced' — 16px/24px/32px rhythm provides breathing room without sparsity, suitable for portfolio and CTA sections.
Section order prioritizes hero → services → portfolio → about → testimonials → cta, matching the warm personal brand voice (let's talk framing last).
All focus indicators use --brand-accent (#6366F1) outline with 2px offset for WCAG AA keyboard accessibility.
